verdict.rationale: Fireworks' own site describes a guided fine-tuning path where you "describe the task, review the plan and cost, approve the run", which is natural-language operation of one product workflow. Tool calling and the OpenAI-compatible API are developer building blocks for building agents, not natural-language control of the platform itself, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: natural-language control beyond fine-tuning (deployments, autoscaling, models, billing), detailed docs on how the guided path works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
